showcase.user_prompt: 把本地免费模型服务跑起来，模型加到模型列表里。
showcase.assistant_reply: 免费模型网关已装好服务器运行时并启动：健康检查通过、模型列表已同步进 Astravia，可以直接在模型选择器里用了。侧边栏「免费模型网关」可随时启停服务、打开管理界面或重新同步模型。上游复用厂商免费通道，使用风险由你自担。

blocks.title: 装完即用，一套界面管起来

items.title: 运行时随包分发
items.description: 上游 standalone 服务器整树打进插件包，由宿主用托管 Node 拉起，端口与数据目录自动注入，无需克隆仓库或配环境。

items.title: 一键启停
items.description: 激活即自动安装并启动，随插件禁用与应用退出自动清理；支持手动启停、重启与日志查看。

items.title: 模型自动入列
items.description: 就绪后读取服务自生成的密钥、拉取 /v1/models 并写入宿主模型注册表，OpenAI 兼容端点即插即用。

items.title: 风险自知
items.description: 页面内置风险声明：上游复用厂商免费通道可能违反其条款，一切后果由使用者自行承担。

showcase.user_prompt: Start my local free-model server and add its models to the model list.
showcase.assistant_reply: The Free Model Gateway installed and started the server runtime: health check passed and the model list is synced into Astravia — pick a model and go. Start/stop the server, open the management UI, or resync models anytime from the sidebar entry. The upstream reuses vendor free channels; you accept the risks.

items.title: Runtime ships with the plugin
items.description: The whole upstream standalone server tree is bundled; the host starts it with its managed Node and injects the port and data directory. No repo clone, no path setup.

items.title: One-click lifecycle
items.description: Installs and starts on activation, cleaned up automatically on plugin disable and app quit; manual start/stop, restart and logs included.

items.title: Models auto-listed
items.description: Once ready it reads the server-generated key, fetches /v1/models and writes them into the host model registry as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

items.title: Informed risk
items.description: A built-in disclaimer: the upstream reuses vendor free channels and may violate their terms; the user accepts all consequences.
